question: What transformations of time and form result from the described yogic attainment?
premises: Time is affected in this state
Form is affected in this state
Deception of time and transformation of form occur
inference: The attainment brings the overcoming of time and the transformation of form.
uncertainties: vañcanaṃ may mean deception, evasion, or transcendence of time
plain_english: O Goddess, there is the overcoming of time and the transformation of form.
